title: R5 assets fleet maintenance and operational lifecycle closure
businessRules: R5 is limited to F31 AssetMaintenancePlan management, F32 VehicleDriverAssignment lifecycle, and F33 asset assign/transfer/dispose operator flow from the master recovery workflow.
AssetMaintenancePlan and VehicleDriverAssignment reuse existing SQLite/PostgreSQL models; R5 introduces no schema or migration change.
Tenant and branch authority always comes from authenticated context; client companyId/branchId compatibility fields cannot select another tenant or branch.
Maintenance plans require a day or odometer interval; odometer schedules are valid only for vehicle assets; optional checklist templates must belong to the authenticated company and be active.
Vehicle-driver assignments reject overlapping duplicate assignments and overlapping primary-driver periods for the same vehicle; active primary assignment projects to Vehicle.defaultDriverEmployeeId.
Asset transfer/disposal continues to require a PASSED or APPROVED Asset operational inspection; Admin must not auto-pass that gate.
F31/F32/F33 are HIGH findings with runtimeEvidenceRequired=true and cannot close from static tests alone.
Human Stage-20 remains PENDING and is never replaced by the R5 automated probe.
acceptanceCriteria: F31 exposes list/create/update lifecycle for AssetMaintenancePlan and preserves worker asset.maintenance.due / CREATE_MAINTENANCE_WORK_ORDER integration.
F32 exposes list/create/end lifecycle for VehicleDriverAssignment with tenant/branch validation, overlap protection, audit, and primary-driver projection.
F33 Admin exposes assign, transfer, dispose/sale, and explicit Asset handover inspection operator controls without weakening the backend inspection gate.
Both GitHub PostgreSQL workflows execute ci:r5:probe against exact runtime source and aggregate evidence requires the R5 gate PASS.
Focused R5 source contract, workflow validation, repository validation, recovery audit, and dependency-free regression pass before push.
R5 remains VERIFICATION until exact-source GitHub PostgreSQL runtime evidence passes; only then may F31/F32/F33 be closed.
testPlan: R5 PostgreSQL runtime disposal verifies the existing ASSET_DISPOSAL balanced journal posting path; R5 does not change journal line construction.
GitHub Full System Simulation / Toko360 Full Automated UAT: npm run ci:r5:probe against live PostgreSQL exact runtime
migrationPlan: No database migration. Existing AssetMaintenancePlan and VehicleDriverAssignment models are reused with SQLite/PostgreSQL schema parity unchanged.
rollbackPlan: Revert R5 API/UI/probe source as one atomic wave. No schema rollback is required. Existing asset, maintenance, fleet, accounting, and inspection records remain authoritative.
monitoringPlan: GitHub R5 evidence records exact source fingerprint and runtime checks for maintenance-plan management, driver-assignment lifecycle, primary-driver projection, asset assignment, inspection-gated transfer, and disposal.
securityNotes: All new API operations keep existing Roles/Permissions decorators and authenticated tenant/branch scoping. Asset handover inspection must be explicitly completed by an operator; transfer/disposal only accepts PASSED/APPROVED inspection status.
releaseEvidence: Human Stage-20 remains PENDING and separate
